summary: In the small hours of 5 Emberfall the party made its first camp together in a hollow south of the goblin trail, beside an old stone Ilsevel identified as a Lamplighter way-marker from the road that ran there before the Lantern Road. Oriel suggested trying to rekindle the dead cores at Father Tobin's altar. When Tamsin sat against the way-marker, the iron key at her throat hummed and she moved away without a word. Tamsin read Ilsevel's notebook while the elf was in trance and put it back with a sprig of heather. On first watch Oriel saw an anvil under the grey paint of Brannoc's shield, and Brannoc, seeing that she fears the dark, gave her his lantern.

npcs.name: Pell
npcs.description: Ilsevel's brown owl familiar. Kept the last watch of the night, and saw Tamsin borrow Ilsevel's notebook.

places.name: Thornpike Woods
places.description: Dark pine woods east of the Lantern Road. South of the goblin trail's fork is a sheltered hollow with an old fire ring and a moss-grown Lamplighter way-marker from the old road that ran there before the Lantern Road was laid.

quotes.speaker: ilsevel
quotes.text: The road moved. The stone stayed.

quotes.speaker: ilsevel
quotes.text: It is a long way of saying I have never been allowed to try.

quotes.speaker: oriel
quotes.text: I sleep with a candle. A priestess of the Lantern-Bearer, twenty-five years old, and I sleep with a candle.

quotes.speaker: brannoc
quotes.text: I see in the dark. You keep it.

quotes.speaker: ilsevel
quotes.text: Pell says he was excellent at it. Pell says nothing happened at all, which is the point of a watch.

events: The party made camp in a sheltered hollow and lit a fire in an old stone ring.
Ilsevel read the moss-covered stone in the hollow: a Lamplighter way-marker from the old road.
Ilsevel explained that dead cores are rekindled at a temple altar by a senior Lamplighter; Oriel suggested Father Tobin's altar.
When Tamsin sat against the way-marker, the plain iron key at her neck hummed; she moved away and told Oriel it was smoke in her eyes.
Tamsin lifted Ilsevel's notebook unnoticed, read Ilsevel's notes about her, and put it back with a sprig of heather.
On first watch Oriel noticed an anvil shape under the grey paint of Brannoc's shield; he said it was old paint.
Brannoc saw that Oriel fears the dark and gave her his lantern.
The party woke rested on the morning of 5 Emberfall.

items.name: Plain iron key
items.note: Worn on a cord at her neck. It hummed when she sat against the old way-marker.

items.name: Brannoc's lantern
items.note: A small lantern Brannoc lit and set by Oriel's bedroll; he sees in the dark.

items.name: Brannoc's grey shield
items.note: Painted grey over an older design; the faint outline of an anvil shows through.

brannoc: His shield is painted over an anvil design he will not talk about.
Gave Oriel his lantern and told her not to thank him.
oriel: Sleeps with a candle; she does not like the dark.
Hums the dusk hymn to fall asleep.
tamsin: Her iron key hummed by the way-marker; she lied that it was smoke in her eyes.
Read Ilsevel's notebook and found Ilsevel had noticed her kindness to Wil.
ilsevel: Rests in an elven trance rather than sleeping.
Is a Lamplighter of the fourth rank; rekindling a core is second-rank work she has never been allowed to try.
